structure: A 78-line Markdown ruling, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates.md, by Sam on 9 October 2026 about templates and the dashboard. It opens with three verbatim quotes (answers-2026-10-09-pm.md points 8, 8a and 7b) and a short framing paragraph saying the ruling only covers what splitting off the templates theme needs, and that claims marked 'applied by the orchestrator from Sam's principle' are the orchestrator's calls, not Sam's words. Then 7 numbered claims in two sections: (a) The dashboard, claims 1 to 3 (INS dashboard summary information blocked; the rest of the INS home goes ahead; the animals notification list stays in the animals frontend, with a new theme restyling it and plants reframed alongside); (b) Templates, claims 4 to 7 (templates CRUD goes ahead with 4 listed areas; template mode walks the same pages without forking; template rows drop look-or-order dependencies on other themes, with the transporter-list note; plants takes the same change in the same increment, with 4 bullets). Scope is the whole file, so nothing is left out. It cites plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json and ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 22 as context, but those are separate sources and not part of this one.

parts.title: The whole ruling
parts.scope: The whole file, top to bottom: the three verbatim quotes, the framing paragraph, and claims 1 to 7 under (a) The dashboard and (b) Templates, including every sub-bullet.
covers: The 3 verbatim quotes (points 8, 8a and 7b): every decision they make, used as the quote each claim is checked against
The framing paragraph: the templates theme split off for a second machine, and which claims are the orchestrator's rather than Sam's
Claim 1: INS dashboard summary information (notification counts, status-change cards, drill-downs) blocked, rows stay blocked, area re-distilled later
Claim 2: Create new and Use template buttons, the 'What are you importing?' question and the Templates navigation item go ahead; home-page dependencies are on those controls only

Claim 3: the live animals notification list stays in the animals frontend; a new theme restyles the animals dashboard to match the prototype; plants' list reframed in the same increments (orchestrator's); replaces claim 22 of ruling:sam-2026-10-09
Claim 4: templates CRUD goes ahead, with its 4 listed areas (Manage templates; start, save, view, change, use, discard, delete; Templates navigation item; the type question)
Claim 5: template mode walks the same pages, same data, maybe different validation; later page changes carry over; no copied pages or forked journey

Claim 6: template rows do not wait on other themes' page changes; its 2 bullets (keep a dependency only for something new that is needed; drop look-or-order dependencies, with the 3 examples) and the orchestrator's transporter-list note (buttons follow today's list; transporter management blocked separately, answers point 5)

Claim 7 (orchestrator's): plants changes in the same increment, with its 4 bullets (type-question entry creating a plants draft; Templates navigation item in plants; context-following back links using plants' step order; animals-only back to the type question and animals-only template mode)
Any gap the ruling clearly leaves open, such as the 'perhaps different validation' in template mode and when the dashboard requirements will firm up
